title: Robata-Grilled Bok Choi with Kissed Skewers
description: A unique Asian-inspired dish featuring grilled bok choi and sweet kissed skewers.

ingredients.name: Kissed Skewers
ingredients.notes: Marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar.

ingredients.name: Robata Sauce
ingredients.notes: For brushing bok choi during grilling

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cut the bok choi into individual leaves and brush with Robata Sauce.
Grill the bok choi for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
In a separate pan, heat the With Soy Sauce over medium heat.
Add the Kissed Skewers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
Serve the grilled bok choi with Kissed Skewers, American Skewers, and a drizzle of Smoke Sauce.
